Lightweight Design

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

Care and presentation

Vacuum or brush for daily dust, rinse with water or machine wash where suitable — flexible cleaning that keeps it fresh and hygienic with minimal effort.
Unique printed patterns add a fashionable finishing touch, while the round shape suits any interior. Entryway, bedroom, garage, patio, office — beautiful wherever it goes.
Five sizes from 40×40cm to 120×120cm — from a compact doormat to a generous round rug, there's a size that's just right.

5037204496600.sourceDescription:
Christmas Tree Skirt
This Christmas tree skirt adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and plush fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plush Fabric. Colour: White. Stated size: 90 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Plush fabric construction provides a soft, defined appearance for festive home displays.
Intricate snowflake detailing adds a winter-themed accent to your Christmas tree base.
Generous 90 cm diameter size ensures effective coverage around the tree trunk.
Classic white colour coordinates seamlessly with various seasonal decoration themes.
For Indoor Use

8941467526400.sourceDescription:
Each bow is cut from velvet ribbon with a soft, smooth pile that feels gentle in the hand and keeps its fullness after tying. The soft pink tone brings a light, romantic look to a tree and lifts darker greenery, while the matte finish avoids any cheap shine. Each bow measures approximately 5 x 10 in (13 x 26 cm), and the ribbon is 1 in wide.

There are 12 bows in the pack, so a whole tree, a wreath and a garland can be dressed from one set. The large scale shows up clearly in photos and from across a room, which makes even a plain tree look styled, and the bows stay light enough to hang from thin branches without dragging them down.

Use them on Christmas tree branches, front door wreaths, garlands and mantelpieces, or to finish stair rails, window frames, fence posts and fireplace surrounds. Knot the tails around a hook or rail and spread the loops so the velvet lies flat against the surface. They work for birthday parties, spring displays, weddings, picnics and everyday room styling. Two or three spaced along a garland give it rhythm without crowding the greenery.

As the bows come ready made, they double as craft supplies. Add them to gift wrap, hampers and handmade decorations, or give a set to friends who enjoy DIY. When the season ends, pack them flat in a dry box so the pile stays smooth and the pink does not fade.

Add a mesmerising modern feature to your festive decor with this LED infinity candy cane from MySmartBuy. 207 bright white LEDs reflect into an infinity mirror tunnel, creating a stunning illusion of depth. Lovely in windows, on shelves and in living rooms and hallways. It is supplied with a 3m lead cable and IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Festive lights are a simple way to bring warmth and atmosphere to dark winter evenings. Group them with candles, greenery and decorations, place them where they can be seen from outside, or use them to create a cosy corner for the family to enjoy throughout December. A simple, stylish way to bring festive sparkle into your home, and a lovely finishing touch for Christmas displays and parties. At a glance: LED infinity candy cane | 207 bright white LEDs | infinity mirror effect | 3m lead cable | IP20 transformer | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor use.
INFINITY CANDY CANE : 207 bright white LEDs with an infinity mirror tunnel effect.
STUNNING DEPTH : A mesmerising festive feature.
3M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 3m lead cable and IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
AUTOMATIC TIMER : Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so it lights up at the same time every evening without you having to remember.
INDOOR DECORATION : Windows, shelves, living rooms and hallways.

5096042277000.sourceDescription:
Multicoloured light travels through the fine fibre optic strands amongst 72 tips. The 50 cm wreath runs on three AA batteries, sold separately, giving you the option to hang it away from mains sockets.

A plain surface gives individual colours room to show. For a coordinated arrangement elsewhere in the room, pick out just one of those colours for ribbon or a small group of ornaments. The fine illuminated ends are part of the decorative effect. Keep them visible among the branches and leave the front of the wreath free from large additions that would hide the small points of light.

Fibre optics bring light to the ends of fine strands, giving the greenery scattered highlights. Seen close up, the small points sit at different depths among the branches. From across the room they draw the eye around the outline. Allow access to the battery compartment when arranging the display. Positioning it where you can change the cells without disturbing the front of the decoration makes a difference if you leave it up throughout the season.

For a window display, test the position from both sides of the glass before making it permanent. Moving the decoration slightly away from a bright reflection can make the individual lights much clearer in the evening. If you are using other Christmas lighting nearby, try the wreath on its own first. A little distance between the light sources helps each point remain visible and lets the pattern around the wreath read clearly.

After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage. On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments.

5096042275600.sourceDescription:
Gold and brown baubles cover a plastic base ring, giving this door wreath its shape and colour. The supplied ribbon makes a neat finishing point at the top and lets you hang the wreath with the baubles facing into the room. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change. At 45 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

Baubles carry the colour across the whole shape, with curves and small gaps creating changes in the way the light falls. That varied surface gives a single wreath much of the visual interest of a group of individual ornaments. Curved bauble surfaces reflect the colours immediately around them. Try hanging the wreath where it catches a little daylight and leave space in front of the decorations to show the different surfaces.

Let the ribbon carry the colour upwards from the wreath. Adjust the drop before making the final fastening and check that the arrangement hangs straight, particularly on a door with strong vertical panels.

A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations. If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass.

For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards. After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges.
Gold and brown baubles cover a plastic base ring for a festive entrance display.
Supplied hanging ribbon allows easy indoor or outdoor placement on doors or walls.
Curved bauble surfaces reflect light to create visual interest and depth.
Compact 45 cm diameter size fits standard doorways and hallway spaces easily.
Comes with Hanging ribbon
Hanging rope included

The cold light source gives pure, bright light and barely warms up, and the theoretical lifespan reaches 50,000 hours or more, so the strand can be reused season after season. Unroll the cable without kinks, keep the power block away from moisture and store the lights dry when the season ends.

This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and fabric and wood construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

5059442204700.sourceDescription:
Nordmann Fir is a hugely popular Christmas tree due to its rich green foliage, soft needles, and naturally well-balanced shape. The broad, sturdy branches provide plenty of room for decorations, while the foliage has excellent needle retention, helping the tree stay looking fresh throughout the Christmas period. The needles are also less prickly than many other conifers, making decorating easy and safe for little hands without the risk of being scratched.
A DISTINCTIVE NORDMANN FIR: The foliage has a rich green colour and a glossy appearance, while the needles are broad, soft, and blunt-tipped. This gives the Nordmann Fir its characteristic look and makes it a particularly popular variety for Christmas.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE THAT HOLDS ITS NEEDLES: Excellent needle retention helps the Nordmann Fir stay fresh-looking throughout the festive period, reducing the amount of fallen foliage as the weeks go by. Strong branches also provide good support for decorations.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: After Christmas, move the tree back outside so it can continue growing in cooler conditions. As it develops, the evergreen foliage can also provide year-round interest among other evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE FOR FLEXIBLE DISPLAY: Growing in a container means the Nordmann Fir can be moved to different positions as needed, making it easier to manage where the tree is placed. This also makes it possible to grow a Christmas tree without committing immediately to planting it permanently in the ground.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
